source.method: Direct evaluated source boneFrames/boneTransforms; source phase unshifted. Angles and normalized wrists are references only; target fixed limb lengths are retained.

coordinates.phase: unshifted source sample index / 144; not female10002 frontmost-aligned
coordinates.pelvis: midpoint of source near/far hip positions
coordinates.limb_angles: absolute XY angle measured hip->knee->ankle, radians
coordinates.foot_angle: source foot world rotation minus same foot Idle frame0 rotation; use lerp_angle
coordinates.wrist: same-side shoulder-to-wrist divided by same frame upper+lower arm lengths
